reviewer: Codex native-size visual and numerical review, 2026-09-13

review_notes.clear_faceted: All 18 native-size chronological sheets: two rigs, 112/256/512 pixels, black/white/game backgrounds, four poses, reference/draft/detail. Synchronized browser motion and individual frame inspection supplement the sheets. Numerical comparisons include both candidate streams and stationary independent reference streams. Draft retains sharp facet boundaries, changing bright wedges, small blue/orange edge fringes and silhouette in all reviewed views. Daylight low contrast occurs in the reference too. No visible halo, missing flash or framing jump. Detail reduces already small residual noise without a material visual benefit in this diagnostic. Limits are bounded regression margins around this reviewed fixture, not universal perceptual limits.

review_notes.rounded: All18 native chronological sheets: two rigs,112/256/512 pixels,black/white/game backgrounds,four poses,reference/draft/detail. The12 previously reviewed sheets retain identical hashes. Remaining six daylight256/512 sheets inspected at native resolution. Synchronized browser inspection and frame stepping cover all four gameplay112 detail poses; no browser errors. Numerical comparisons include both candidate streams and independent stationary reference streams. Detail retains fine white/dark facet lines, narrow chromatic fringes, moving bright wedges and silhouette. Daylight gray planes and lower bright reflections match the reference. Select detail for this rounded diagnostic and retain its measured extra cost. Limits are case-specific regression margins, not universal perceptual limits. Reference daylight256 pose1 was checkpoint-resumed; its recorded wall time is only the resumed attempt, not fresh total cost.
review_notes.rough: All18 native chronological sheets: two rigs,112/256/512px,black/white/game backgrounds,all four poses and reference/draft/detail/refined. Previous12 reviewed sheets retain exact hashes. Browser daylight112 refined stepping inspects all four poses including loop return; no browser errors. Numerical comparisons include both candidate streams and independent stationary16384-sample references. Select1024-sample one-pass refined. It retains central reflection gradients, narrow moving daylight streaks, edge transitions and bright wedges. Draft flattens gradients and alters/softens some highlights; unfiltered512-sample detail has conspicuous grain. Refined has modest residual grain at512 but preserves the changing structure much closer to the unfiltered reference. Small residual loss of motion amplitude is measured (gain about0.9964..0.9984), not hidden. Limits are bounded regression margins for this diagnostic, not a universal rough-surface quality claim or calibrated wear preset. Cost remains recorded separately.
review_notes.localized_volume: All18 full native chronological sheets: two rigs,112/256/512px,black/white/game backgrounds,four poses and reference/draft/detail.
